Subject: A faded old wall mural in a dim stone hall: a young prince in a gold circlet raising a sword before a horde of crude pit creatures (small goblins and bony shapes) crawling out of a black pit. Painted like an old church mural with cracks and flaking paint; the prince heroic and tall, the creatures small and many. Dim torchlight on the wall

An evening square in a small medieval town, lanterns lit. Close view of a young woman in a simple dress and a mercenary captain seen from behind (his face not visible, broad shoulders, worn leather coat). His hands pin a small white lily brooch on her dress. Her face quiet, serious and tender. Behind them, a white lily banner on a pole

A dim throne room. A king in gold robes on a high throne, his face half in shadow, pointing forward as he gives an order. Below him a band of kneeling mercenaries seen from behind, a white lily banner among them. Behind the mercenaries stands a young woman with a white lily brooch; the king's gaze rests on her, not on the mercenaries

Night at the edge of a huge black pit in a dead forest, torches. Soldiers in plain iron helmets turn against the mercenaries beside them; under the helmets their faces have become monstrous: ash-grey skin, flat pale sickly green eyes without pupils, crooked teeth. Mercenaries under a white lily banner caught by surprise. The chaos is shown by silhouettes

Looking up from the dark bottom of a black pit: steep earthen walls, the rim far above against the night sky, one torch at the rim and the small dark silhouette of a crowned king looking down. Pale sickly green glints of eyes in the dark around the bottom. The viewer lies at the bottom of the pit

A crowded courtroom hall in grey daylight from high windows. A chained man kneels before a judge's bench, seen from behind, his right sleeve ending in a bandaged stump. In the crowd, one young woman's face in grief, a small white lily brooch on her dress

A prison cell wall covered from floor to ceiling with thousands of scratched tally marks in rows. Through a crack low in the stone, an old knight's bony hand reaches in. Faint grey light from a tiny barred window. No person in full view
Night. A burial sack falling from the top of a tall prison wall on a cliff into a black river far below. Moonlight on the water, the dark prison tower above

A slave market in a muddy town square under a grey sky. A thin girl in chains stands on a low wooden block: ink-stained fingers, a sharp, cold, clever face. In the foreground, a left hand in a dark glove offers gold coins; the buyer is only a dark shoulder seen from behind

An open old ledger on a wooden table, its pages filled with rows of small scribbled marks. Through the window behind it, the sun in a pale sky with a black bite taken out of one edge, as if bitten by a beast

The edge of a dead forest at dusk, a black pit in the distance. In the foreground, a man's arm with no right hand, the sleeve wrapped at the stump, and a black stain like spilled ink spreading from the wrist up the arm. The man is turning his back to the pit

A distant palace balcony at dusk, seen from below across a courtyard. A queen in a plain grey gown stands alone at the railing, a small white lily brooch on her chest, looking far away. Banners with a golden sun crest hang from the palace

A small village at night. A hooded figure seen from behind raises a banner with a black-painted lily on a pole. Under a lantern, mercenaries of different kinds (a big warrior with an axe, an archer, a hooded mage) step down from a stagecoach
